label: kizuna_head_c_02
text: A good friend of mine has been telling me of\nyour recent exploits.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_c_03
text: Ha ha... I’ll leave their identity to your\nimagination.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_c_04
text: But now, lest I forget, there is another matter\nI would very much like your opinion on.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_c_05
text: Do you know what manner of gentleman’s\nhairstyle is considered cool, as it were, among\r\nthe youth these days?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_c_06a
text: Oh? Is that so?\c\nI suppose I have indeed seen some of the\nacademy’s male students sporting such a style.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_c_06b
text: Oho! Pompadours, you say? I suspected as much!\c\nThough I don’t seem to recall many of the\nacademy’s male students sporting such a style...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_c_07
text: Could it be, then, that the pompadour has\nalready had its day in the sun...?\c\nPerhaps I ought to consider a change of wig...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_c_08
text: Ah. That is to say... Never mind.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

text:
